    Rational magnitude of a finite Hom-finite category #

    For a finite chosen skeleton, the Leinster magnitude is the total sum of the inverse of the rational Hom-dimension matrix. The Hom--mesh inverse theorem identifies that inverse with the integral mesh matrix, proving the frozen manuscript's magnitude formula rather than merely its combinatorial analogue.
